theorem: Prime rank pi(P) and trace-matched oscillator rank floor(log P) have divergent difference, so their support projections cannot converge in Hilbert-Schmidt distance.
opposite_failure: Rank matching with K=pi(P) makes oscillator covariance grow like log P rather than log log P.
interpretation: Scalar covariance-trace cancellation does not imply quasi-free or Bogoliubov equivalence.
surviving_target: A weighted many-to-one prime-shell correspondence, multiplicity-enriched reference, Krein quotient, or nonunitary relative determinant.
status: simple gamma quasi-free comparison falsified; enriched correspondence open
